description: Retrieve a published beverage profile by exact slug, with claim preview, evidence and recorded offers. The preview contains at most 20 claims; evidence scans at most 100 claims and quotes selected recorded statements and public sources in alcohol, ingredients_technique and sensory only, excluding offer-tagged claims. Evidence is not the full inventory, even when has_more is false. not_found_in_scanned_claims means no scanned claim matched the alcohol selector, not that no statement exists or that alcohol is zero. Alcohol declarations retain their exact wording; missing alcohol information is unknown. data.offers contains recorded sellers and links and any available price, currency, size, date and delivery fields. An offer is not current stock or guaranteed delivery; no recorded offers does not mean the drink is sold nowhere. Claim-source prices can be historical, expired or stockist evidence and are distinct from offer prices. Beyond Wine is a published reference for no/low ABV specialty beverages in fine dining, including wine alternatives, craft ferments, kombucha, teas and blends. It excludes non-alcoholic beer, non-alcoholic spirits, mocktails, mixers, dealcoholized wine and blends containing dealcoholized wine. The connection cannot place orders or take payments and cannot guarantee every drink contains absolutely no alcohol.
name: get_beverage
title: Get beverage
